name: handoff
description: Generate a self-contained handoff prompt that lets the user continue work in a fresh coding agent session with empty context. The prompt captures everything a new agent needs: project, goal, progress, decisions, current state, and remaining work. **Triggers — use this skill when:** - User says "handoff", "hand off", "hand-off" - User asks to "generate a continuation prompt" - User says "give me a prompt to continue this" - User asks to "wrap up for a new session" - User says "context transfer", "session transfer" - User asks "how do I pick this up later" - User wants to "pass this to another agent"
